title: A Sponge Under the Sea
ru: Кто такой Губка Боб, где он живёт и кто его друзья
text:
A yellow sponge lives in a pineapple at the bottom of the sea. Kids all over the world know his name: SpongeBob SquarePants!

SpongeBob is a yellow sea sponge with big eyes, square brown pants and a very loud laugh. He lives in Bikini Bottom, a busy town at the bottom of the ocean. His house is a big orange pineapple. His pet is a snail called Gary, and Gary says “meow” like a cat.

SpongeBob works at the Krusty Krab, a fast-food restaurant. He makes burgers called Krabby Patties, and he loves his job more than anything. His boss, Mr. Krabs, is a red crab. He loves money even more. Next door lives Squidward, an octopus. Squidward plays the clarinet badly and hates his job, his neighbors and, most of all, SpongeBob.

SpongeBob's best friend is Patrick Star, a pink starfish. Patrick lives under a rock and is not very smart, but he is always happy. Their friend Sandy is a squirrel from Texas. She lives under the sea in a glass house full of air, and she wears a helmet outside.

Here is a fun fact: the creator of the show, Stephen Hillenburg, was once a teacher of marine biology, the science of life in the sea. The show started in 1999, and people of all ages still love it.

questions.q: What is SpongeBob's house?
How does Squidward feel about SpongeBob?
What did Stephen Hillenburg teach before the show?
o: The science of life in the sea

title: Peppa and Her Family
ru: Простой рассказ о свинке Пеппе и её семье
text:
Peppa is a little pink pig. She is four years old, she snorts when she laughs, and she has one big love in life: jumping in muddy puddles.

Peppa Pig is a cartoon from Britain. It started in 2004, and the episodes are very short, only about five minutes. Nothing big happens. Peppa goes to playgroup, visits Grandpa Pig, rides her bike or plays in the rain. But every little story has a joke, and that is why kids watch it again and again.

Peppa lives in a house on a hill with her family. Her little brother George loves his toy dinosaur and takes it everywhere. When someone says “dinosaur”, George shouts “Dine-saw! Grrr!” Mummy Pig is calm and clever. Daddy Pig has a big round tummy and glasses, and he thinks he is an expert on everything. He usually isn't. Peppa's best friend is Suzy Sheep, and her other friends are animals too: rabbits, cats, dogs and zebras.

The cartoon is good for learners because the characters speak slowly and clearly, with a nice British accent. Some American parents even joke that their children start to talk like little British kids after watching Peppa. And how does a typical episode end? Everybody laughs so hard that they fall on the floor.

questions.q: What does Peppa love to do most?
What does George take everywhere?
Why is the cartoon good for learners?
o: The characters speak slowly and clearly

title: A Cat and a Mouse
ru: Вечная погоня кота и мыши без слов
text:
A cat runs. A mouse runs faster. A door closes, a frying pan flies, and the cat is suddenly as flat as a pancake. This is Tom and Jerry, one of the most famous cartoons in the world.

Tom is a gray and white house cat. Jerry is a small brown mouse, and he lives in a little hole in the wall. Tom wants to catch Jerry. Jerry wants to eat cheese and make Tom's life difficult. Every episode is a chase, and almost every time, the little mouse wins.

The funny thing is that the characters almost never talk. You don't need any words, because the story is in the action: faces, crashes, screams and fast music. That is why people in every country understand it. Sometimes there is a third star, Spike, a big angry bulldog. When Tom wakes him up, Tom has a very bad day.

Two young artists, William Hanna and Joseph Barbera, made the first Tom and Jerry cartoon in 1940. In it, the cat had a different name, Jasper. Later he became Tom. The short films won seven Oscars, and people still watch them today.

But are Tom and Jerry enemies or friends? Sometimes, when a bigger danger comes, they work together. Then the chase starts again.

questions.q: Why do people in every country understand the cartoon?
o: It has subtitles in all languages

questions.q: Who is Spike?
What was Tom's name in the first cartoon?

title: A Green Ogre
ru: Знакомство с огром Шреком и его друзьями
text:
Once upon a time, there was a beautiful princess... and an ogre who read about her in a book and then used the page as toilet paper. That is how Shrek begins, and you know right away that this fairy tale is different.

Shrek is an ogre, a big green monster from old stories. He lives alone in a swamp, a wet place full of mud. He likes mud baths and quiet evenings, and he doesn't like visitors. But one day his swamp is suddenly full of fairy tale characters: the Three Little Pigs, Pinocchio, the Gingerbread Man and many more. The small and very angry Lord Farquaad sent them all away from his city.

To get his swamp back, Shrek must save Princess Fiona from a tower, and a dragon guards the tower. A talking donkey, called simply Donkey, goes with him. Donkey talks, and talks, and never stops talking. Shrek tries to get rid of him, but Donkey becomes his friend anyway.

Shrek is not a simple monster. “Ogres are like onions,” he says. They have layers, and under the angry face there is a big heart.

DreamWorks made the film in 2001. It was a big hit, and it won the very first Oscar for Best Animated Feature.

questions.q: Where does Shrek live?
What is Donkey's main habit?
Why does Shrek compare ogres to onions?

title: Toys Are Alive
ru: Первый полностью компьютерный мультфильм: живые игрушки
text:
What do your toys do when you leave the room? In Toy Story, the answer is simple: they come alive. They walk, talk, have meetings and worry about their owner, a boy called Andy. But when a human comes in, they fall down and don't move.

Woody is a cowboy doll with a pull string and a big hat. He is Andy's favorite toy, and he is the leader in Andy's room. His friends are a funny group: Mr. Potato Head, Rex, a big green dinosaur who is afraid of everything, Hamm the piggy bank and Slinky the dog.

Then, on Andy's birthday, a new toy arrives. His name is Buzz Lightyear, and he is a space ranger with lights, wings and a laser. There is one problem: Buzz doesn't know that he is a toy. He thinks he is a real hero from space. “To infinity and beyond!” he shouts. Soon Andy loves Buzz more than Woody, and Woody is very, very jealous.

Toy Story came out in 1995, and it made history. Pixar made the whole film on computers. It was the first feature film like this, and today most animated films are made this way. Tom Hanks gave Woody his voice, and Tim Allen was Buzz.

questions.q: What do the toys do when a human comes in?
o: They fall down and don't move

questions.q: What does Buzz Lightyear think at first?
o: That he is a real space hero

questions.q: Why is Toy Story important in history?
o: It was the first cartoon with music
It was the first film about toys
It was the first feature film made fully on computers

title: A Little Fish
ru: Папа-рыбка ищет сына в огромном океане
text:
The ocean is big. A little fish is very small. And a father who is afraid of everything must swim across that ocean to find his son. This is the story of Finding Nemo.

Marlin is a clownfish, an orange fish with white stripes. He lives in a sea anemone, a soft sea animal that looks like a flower, on the Great Barrier Reef near Australia. His son Nemo has one small fin, but Nemo calls it his “lucky fin”. Marlin worries about his son all the time. Nemo is tired of it.

On Nemo's first day of school, he swims out to a boat in open water to show that he is brave. A diver catches him, and soon Nemo is in a fish tank in a dentist's office in Sydney. Marlin decides to find him.

On the way, he meets Dory, a blue fish with a very bad memory. She forgets things after a few seconds, but she is kind, brave and always happy. Her motto is “Just keep swimming.” Together they meet sharks who don't want to eat fish anymore, turtles who talk like surfers, and a lot of danger.

Pixar made the film in 2003, and it won an Oscar. It is funny, but it is also a story about a father who must learn to let his child go.

questions.q: What is special about Nemo's fin?
o: It is small, and he calls it his lucky fin

questions.q: Where does Nemo end up?
o: In a fish tank in a dentist's office

questions.q: What is Dory's problem?

title: Two Sisters and Snow
ru: Две сестры, снежная магия и весёлый снеговик
text:
Elsa can make snow with her hands. She can build a snowman, an ice bridge or a whole castle. It sounds wonderful, but for Elsa it is a big secret and a big fear.

Frozen is a Disney film from 2013. It takes place in Arendelle, a small kingdom by the sea with mountains and cold winters. Elsa and Anna are sisters and princesses. When they are little, they play together with Elsa's magic. Then something goes wrong, and Elsa stops playing. She stays in her room for years. Anna doesn't understand why.

On the day Elsa becomes queen, everyone sees her magic. She is scared, so she runs away to the mountains and builds a palace of ice. There she sings “Let It Go”, the most famous song of the film. But now there is winter everywhere in Arendelle, in the middle of summer!

Anna goes to bring her sister back. She gets help from Kristoff, a young man who sells ice, and his reindeer Sven. They also meet Olaf, a funny little snowman. Olaf's dream is to see summer. Nobody tells him what happens to snow in the sun.

The idea comes from an old fairy tale by Hans Christian Andersen, The Snow Queen. Frozen won two Oscars, one of them for “Let It Go”.

questions.q: What does Elsa do after everyone sees her magic?
o: She runs away to the mountains

questions.q: What is Olaf's dream?
Who is Kristoff?
o: A young man who sells ice

title: Small, Yellow and Funny
ru: Кто такие миньоны и почему их все любят
text:
They are small and yellow. They wear goggles and blue overalls. They have one eye or two, and they get very excited when they see a banana. Yes, these are the Minions.

The Minions first appeared in the cartoon Despicable Me in 2010. In that film, they work for Gru, a bad guy with a big plan: he wants to steal the Moon. The Minions help him, but they also break things, fight, laugh at silly jokes and cause a lot of chaos. Many viewers came for the story and stayed for the little yellow helpers.

Their language is special too. It is a funny mix of words from English, Spanish, French, Italian and other languages, and some words are just nonsense. You can't learn it, but somehow you understand it. The voice behind most of the Minions is Pierre Coffin, one of the film's directors.

In 2015, the Minions got their own film. It shows their history from the very beginning. They always want to serve the biggest, baddest boss, but every boss has bad luck with them. Three Minions, Kevin, Stuart and Bob, go on a trip to find a new master.

Why does everyone love them? Maybe because they are like children: happy, loud, loyal and a little bit crazy.

questions.q: What do Minions get excited about?
What is Gru's plan in Despicable Me?
Who is the voice of most Minions?

title: The Young Lion
ru: История львёнка Симбы в Африке (без спойлеров)
text:
The sun rises over Africa. Animals of every kind walk to a big rock. There, an old baboon holds a tiny lion cub high in the air, and everybody bows. The little lion is Simba, and one day he will be king.

The Lion King is a Disney cartoon from 1994. Simba's father, Mufasa, is the king of the Pride Lands. He is strong, wise and kind. He teaches his son that every animal is part of the “Circle of Life”. But Simba is young and wants adventure. He wants to be king now, not later!

Not everyone is happy about the little prince. Mufasa's brother, Scar, wants to be king himself. He is thin, clever and very dangerous, and he has friends: a group of hungry hyenas. Scar has a plan, and it changes Simba's life.

Later, Simba meets two new friends: Timon, a small talkative meerkat, and Pumbaa, a big friendly warthog, a kind of wild pig. They teach him their favorite words, “Hakuna Matata”. These are real words in Swahili, a language of East Africa, and they mean “no worries”.

The film has great music by Elton John and Hans Zimmer. In 2019, Disney made a new version with very realistic animals.

questions.q: Who wants to be king instead of Mufasa?
What does “Hakuna Matata” mean?
What kind of animal is Pumbaa?
o: A warthog, a kind of wild pig

title: A Panda Who Loves Kung Fu
ru: Толстый панда По мечтает стать мастером кунг-фу
text:
Po is big, soft and always hungry. He works in his father's noodle shop, and he can't climb stairs without stopping for a rest. But in his dreams, he is a great kung fu warrior.

Kung Fu Panda is a DreamWorks cartoon from 2008. It takes place in the Valley of Peace in old China. All the characters are animals. Po's father, Mr. Ping, is a goose. Yes, a goose. Just don't ask.

Po loves kung fu more than anything. His heroes are the Furious Five: Tigress, Monkey, Mantis, Viper and Crane. They are the best fighters in China, and their teacher is Master Shifu, a small and very strict red panda.

One day, the old and wise turtle Master Oogway must choose the Dragon Warrior, the greatest hero of all. Everybody waits. And by a funny accident, he chooses... Po! Shifu is angry. The Furious Five laugh. And Po doesn't know any kung fu at all.

At the same time, a dangerous snow leopard, Tai Lung, is coming back to the valley. Can a fat panda who loves dumplings learn kung fu in time? The film is very funny, but it also has a nice message: believe in yourself. Jack Black gives Po his voice, and he is perfect for the role.

questions.q: Where does Po work?
What kind of animal is Po's father?
Who chooses Po as the Dragon Warrior?

title: A World of Cars
ru: Гоночная машина Молния Маккуин в маленьком городке
text:
Imagine a world with no people, only cars. Cars drive, talk, drink fuel at cafes and watch races. This is the world of Cars, a Pixar cartoon from 2006.

The hero is Lightning McQueen, a red race car with the number 95. He is fast, young and very sure of himself. He doesn't need friends, he says. He only needs to win. His favorite word is “Ka-chow!”

McQueen is on his way to a big race in California. But one night, he gets lost and arrives in Radiator Springs, a tiny forgotten town on the old Route 66. There he breaks the main road by accident, and the town judge says: fix it! So the famous race car must work in a town where nobody knows his name.

The people there, sorry, the cars, are funny and kind. Mater is an old rusty tow truck, a truck that pulls broken cars. He has a big smile and he quickly becomes McQueen's best friend. Sally is a smart blue car who loves the town. And Doc Hudson, the old judge, has a secret from his past.

Slowly McQueen learns that life is not only about speed. Fun fact: Radiator Springs is not real, but many real towns on Route 66 inspired it.

questions.q: What number does Lightning McQueen have?
Why must McQueen stay in Radiator Springs?
o: He must fix the road he broke
He wants to win a race there

questions.q: What is Mater?

title: A Bear Who Loves Honey
ru: Медвежонок Пух и его друзья из Чудесного леса
text:
Winnie the Pooh is a bear with a round tummy, a red shirt and one big problem: he always wants honey. Once he ate so much honey at Rabbit's house that he got stuck in the door. His friends had to wait a whole week for him to get thin again.

Pooh lives in the Hundred Acre Wood with his friends. Piglet is very small and afraid of almost everything, but he is a good friend. Eeyore is an old gray donkey. He is always sad, and his tail sometimes falls off. Tigger is the opposite: he bounces on his tail all day and never stops. There are also clever Owl, busy Rabbit, and Kanga with little Roo in her pocket. Their human friend is a boy called Christopher Robin.

An English writer, A. A. Milne, wrote the first book about Pooh in 1926. Christopher Robin was his real son, and most of the animals were his son's real toys. And the name? Part of it came from a real bear, Winnipeg, at the London Zoo. Later, Disney made the famous cartoons.

Pooh also invented a game, Poohsticks. Everyone drops a stick into a river from one side of a bridge, then runs to the other side. Whose stick comes out first? People in England still play it today.

questions.q: Why did Pooh get stuck in Rabbit's door?
Who was the real Christopher Robin?
How do you play Poohsticks?
o: You hide sticks in the wood
You build a house from sticks
You drop sticks into a river from a bridge

title: Six Friends in New York
ru: Шесть друзей, Нью-Йорк и любимое кафе — знаменитый ситком «Друзья».
text:
A girl in a wedding dress runs into a coffee shop in New York. She doesn't want to marry her boyfriend, and she has nowhere to go. This is how Friends begins, and for ten years, millions of people watched these six friends every week.

Friends is an American sitcom, a funny TV show with the same characters in every episode. It started in 1994 and ended in 2004. The six friends are in their twenties. They work, fall in love, have problems and spend a lot of time together, usually on the big orange sofa in their favorite cafe, Central Perk.

Rachel is the girl in the wedding dress. At first she works as a waitress in Central Perk, a bad one. Monica is a chef and the most organized person in the world. Her brother Ross is a scientist. He loves dinosaurs and has a long story with Rachel. Chandler makes jokes all the time, especially when he is nervous. Joey is an actor, but not a very successful one, and he never shares his food. Phoebe is a little strange. She plays the guitar and sings a song about a smelly cat.

Many people around the world learn English with Friends. The jokes are fast, but the language is natural and real.

questions.q: How does Rachel arrive in the first episode?
Where do the friends spend a lot of time?
What does Joey never do?

title: A Yellow Family
ru: Жёлтая семья из Спрингфилда: кто есть кто в «Симпсонах».
text:
They are yellow. They have four fingers on each hand. And they live in a town called Springfield. Meet the Simpsons, the most famous cartoon family in the world.

Homer is the father. He works at a nuclear power plant, but he usually sleeps there. He loves donuts and TV, and when something goes wrong, he shouts “D'oh!” Marge is the mother. She is patient and kind, and she has very tall blue hair. Bart is ten years old. He rides a skateboard, plays tricks on everyone and hates school. His sister Lisa is eight, and she is the smartest person in the family. She reads a lot and plays the saxophone. Maggie is the baby. She never talks, but she always has her pacifier, the little rubber thing for babies' mouths.

The creator of the show is Matt Groening. He gave the characters the names of his own family: his father was Homer, his mother was Margaret, and he had sisters called Lisa and Maggie. Bart is different. The name comes from the word “brat”, a bad child.

The Simpsons started in 1989, and it is still on TV. No American cartoon series has run for longer. And Bart is still ten.

questions.q: Where does Homer work?
Which family member plays the saxophone?
Where did Matt Groening get most of the names?

title: A Man With No Words
ru: Мистер Бин почти не говорит, но его понимают во всём мире.
text:
A man in a brown jacket and a thin red tie looks at the world like a curious child. He almost never speaks. Sometimes he makes a funny noise or says one word. And people laugh at him in almost every country on Earth.

This is Mr. Bean, a British comedy from the early 1990s. Rowan Atkinson plays Mr. Bean, and he created the character with the writer Richard Curtis. The show uses almost no words, so you don't need any language to understand it. The jokes are in his face, his body and his very strange ideas.

Mr. Bean always has a problem, and he always finds the craziest way to solve it. He gets dressed while driving his car. He cooks a turkey and gets his head stuck in it. In one episode, he buys a big armchair, ties it to the roof of his car and then drives the car from the armchair!

His car is a small green Mini, and he loves it. His best friend is Teddy, a little brown teddy bear. Mr. Bean talks to Teddy and even puts him to bed.

Here is a surprise: before he became a famous comedian, Rowan Atkinson studied electrical engineering at Oxford.

questions.q: Why can people everywhere understand the show?
Where does Mr. Bean sit while driving in one episode?
o: In an armchair on the roof

questions.q: What did Rowan Atkinson study at Oxford?

title: A Blue Box in Time
ru: Доктор Кто — пришелец, который путешествует во времени в синей будке.
text:
On a quiet street, there is an old blue police box. You open the door and step inside... and suddenly you are in a huge room full of lights and machines. It is bigger on the inside! This is the TARDIS, a time machine, and its owner is called the Doctor.

Doctor Who is a British TV show. It started in 1963 on the BBC, and it is the longest-running science fiction show in the world. The Doctor looks human, but he, or sometimes she, is an alien, a Time Lord from another planet. The Doctor has two hearts and no gun. Instead, the Doctor carries a sonic screwdriver, a small tool that can open doors and fix machines.

The Doctor travels through space and time with a companion, usually a human friend. In one episode they meet William Shakespeare. In another, they are on a spaceship far in the future. Their most famous enemies are the Daleks, angry aliens in metal shells who scream “Exterminate!”

Why are there so many actors in the role? When the Doctor is about to die, the Doctor can regenerate, that is, get a new body and a new face. It is a clever idea: the show can live forever, with a new Doctor every few years.

questions.q: What is special about the TARDIS?
o: It can fly like a plane
It is bigger on the inside

questions.q: What does the Doctor carry instead of a gun?
Why are there many actors in the role of the Doctor?
o: The Doctor can get a new body and face

title: Kids, Bikes and Mystery
ru: Дети на велосипедах, 80-е и тайна маленького городка — «Очень странные дела».
text:
It is 1983 in Hawkins, a small town in Indiana, USA. Four boys play a long fantasy game in a basement. Then they ride their bikes home in the dark. Only three of them get home. Will Byers disappears, and nobody can find him.

Stranger Things is a Netflix show by the Duffer brothers. It started in 2016 and ended in 2025. It feels like a love letter to the 1980s: walkie-talkies, video arcades, big hair and great music.

Will's friends Mike, Dustin and Lucas don't wait for the police. They take their bikes and start to look for him. In the forest, they find a strange girl with very short hair. She doesn't talk much, she loves Eggo waffles, and she has a number, not a name: Eleven. Soon they learn that Eleven can move things with her mind.

At home, Will's mother Joyce is sure that her son is alive. She hangs Christmas lights all over the house, and the lights start to blink. Is it Will? Meanwhile, something terrible lives in the dark. The boys call it the Demogorgon, a name from their favorite game, Dungeons & Dragons.

The show is scary, but it is also about friendship. These kids are brave, funny and loyal, and they never leave a friend behind.

questions.q: What happens to Will Byers?
What does Eleven love to eat?
Where does the name “Demogorgon” come from?

title: A Girl in Black
ru: Уэнсдэй Аддамс в необычной школе — мрачная и смешная история.
text:
Wednesday Addams never smiles. She wears only black and white, she has two long dark braids, and she loves anything dark and creepy. She is not a typical teenager, and that is exactly why people love her.

Wednesday is a Netflix show. It started in 2022, and Tim Burton directed many of the episodes. Jenna Ortega plays Wednesday. The character is old: she comes from the Addams Family, a strange, dark family from magazine cartoons of the 1930s.

At the start of the show, Wednesday has big problems at her normal school, so her parents send her to Nevermore Academy. It is a school for outcasts, people who don't fit in: vampires, werewolves, sirens and other unusual teenagers. Wednesday doesn't want to be there. She wants to run away.

Her roommate is Enid, a happy werewolf who loves pink and bright colors. They are complete opposites, and their friendship is one of the best parts of the show. Wednesday also has a helper, Thing. Thing is a hand. Just a hand. It walks on its fingers.

Soon Wednesday discovers a mystery: something is killing people in the woods near the school. She starts to investigate. Fun fact: in one episode Wednesday does a strange dance at a school party, and millions of people copied it on TikTok.

questions.q: Why do Wednesday's parents send her to Nevermore Academy?
o: She has problems at her normal school
She wants to be a vampire

questions.q: What is Thing?
o: A hand that walks on its fingers

questions.q: What did millions of people copy on TikTok?

title: A World of Blocks
ru: Мир из кубиков, где можно построить всё что угодно.
text:
You wake up in a world made of blocks. There are blocks of grass, sand, stone and water. You have nothing, not even a stick. So you walk to a tree and hit it with your hand until you get wood. This is how a game of Minecraft starts.

A Swedish programmer, Markus Persson, started making the game, and his company Mojang released the full version in 2011. In 2014, Microsoft bought Mojang. Today Minecraft is the best-selling video game in history.

In Minecraft, you can build anything: a small house, a big castle, a city or even a working computer. In Creative mode, you have all the blocks you want and you can fly. In Survival mode, it is harder. You must find food and make tools. And when night comes, the monsters come too: zombies, skeletons and giant spiders.

The most famous monster is the Creeper. It is green, it doesn't make a sound, and it comes very close to you. Then you hear a quiet “hiss”, and boom! Your house now has a big hole in it. Here is a fun fact: the Creeper was a mistake. The creator wanted to make a pig, but he mixed up the numbers for its body.

In 2025, the game also became a film, A Minecraft Movie, with Jack Black.

questions.q: How do you get your first wood in Minecraft?
o: You buy it in a shop
You hit a tree with your hand
You find it in a house

questions.q: What happens in Survival mode at night?
How did the Creeper appear?
o: It was a mistake when making a pig

title: The Man in the Red Hat
ru: Марио — самый известный герой видеоигр из Японии.
text:
He is short. He has a big moustache and a red hat with the letter M on it. He is a plumber — a man who fixes pipes. And he is maybe the most famous video game hero in the world.

Super Mario Bros. came out in Japan in 1985. Nintendo made it, and a young designer, Shigeru Miyamoto, created it. The story is simple. Bowser, a big angry turtle king, takes Princess Peach. Mario runs, jumps and goes down green pipes to save her.

The world of the game is strange and funny. Mario eats a mushroom and becomes big. He takes a flower and can throw fire. He jumps on little brown mushroom monsters, and they go flat. At the end of many levels, he jumps onto a tall flagpole.

Here is a surprise: Mario is older than this game. He first appeared in 1981, in Donkey Kong, and his name was Jumpman. And why the moustache? The pictures in old games were very small, and a moustache was easier to draw than a mouth.

In the first castle, Mario wins the fight, and a little character tells him: “Thank you Mario! But our princess is in another castle!” So Mario runs on. More than forty years later, he is still running.

questions.q: What is Mario's job?
What was Mario's name in Donkey Kong?
What happens when Mario eats a mushroom?

title: A Game From Moscow
ru: Тетрис придумал Алексей Пажитнов в Москве — и в него играет весь мир.
text:
Some games need a big team and a lot of money. Tetris needed one man and one old computer.

In 1984 Alexey Pajitnov worked at a computer centre in Moscow. He loved puzzles, and in his free time he made a game. His computer was very simple. It could not show pictures — only letters and symbols. But that was enough.

The idea is easy. Shapes fall from the top of the screen, one by one. Every shape has four squares. There are seven different shapes, and some of them look like the letters L, T and S. You turn them and move them. When you fill a whole line from left to right, the line disappears. When the shapes reach the top, the game is over.

And the name? “Tetra” means “four” in Greek, and Pajitnov loved tennis. Tetra plus tennis — Tetris!

Soon people copied the game from computer to computer, and it went to other countries. In 1989 it came with Nintendo's new Game Boy, and the whole world started to play. On the Game Boy you can hear an old Russian song, “Korobeiniki”. Millions of players know it, but many don't know it is Russian.

Many players say one more thing: after a long game of Tetris, they see falling shapes when they close their eyes.

questions.q: Where did Pajitnov make Tetris?
How many squares does every shape have?
Where does the name Tetris come from?

title: Monsters in Your Pocket
ru: Покемоны — «карманные монстры» из Японии и жёлтый Пикачу.
text:
When Satoshi Tajiri was a boy in Japan, he loved to catch insects. He looked for them in the fields near his home. Years later, the city grew and the fields disappeared. But Tajiri had an idea: a game where children could catch and collect little monsters.

That game came out in Japan in 1996, on Nintendo's small Game Boy. Tajiri's company, Game Freak, made it. The full name is Pocket Monsters, and the short name is Pokémon.

In the game you are a young trainer. You walk through towns, grass and caves. Wild Pokémon jump out of the tall grass. You fight them with your own Pokémon, then throw a Poké Ball — a red and white ball — to catch them. The first games had 151 Pokémon. And one great idea: you could trade Pokémon with a friend, with a cable between two Game Boys.

The most famous Pokémon is Pikachu, a yellow electric mouse with red cheeks. Pikachu became a star of the anime, which started in 1997. There it can only say its name: “Pika pika!” Its trainer is a boy called Ash. In Japan his name is Satoshi — like the creator of the game!

Today Pokémon is one of the biggest brands in the world. And it all started with a boy and some insects.

questions.q: What did Tajiri love to catch as a boy?
What do you throw to catch a Pokémon?
What colour is Pikachu?

title: Make Your Own Life
ru: The Sims — игра, где ты строишь дом и управляешь жизнью человечков.
text:
Most games give you a sword, a gun or a fast car. The Sims gives you a house, a family and a very full fridge. Or a very empty fridge — it is your choice.

The game came out in 2000. Will Wright created it at Maxis, an American studio. Before that, he made SimCity, a game about building a whole city. In The Sims he went small: one street, one house, a few people.

First you make your Sims. You choose their faces, their clothes and their personality. Then you build a house for them: walls, windows, a kitchen, maybe a pool. After that, life starts. Your Sims need to eat, sleep, wash, go to work and see friends. When they don't sleep, they are tired and angry. When they don't go to the toilet... well, you can guess.

Above your Sim's head there is a diamond. It shows how the Sim feels: green is happy, red is unhappy. And the Sims speak their own language, Simlish. It sounds like real talking, but it means nothing at all.

Players do strange things in this game. Here is a famous example: a Sim is swimming in the pool, and the player takes away the ladder. Poor Sim! In The Sims you are like a god — and not always a kind one.

questions.q: Who created The Sims?
What is Simlish?
What does the diamond above a Sim show?
o: How much money the Sim has

title: Who Is the Impostor?
ru: Among Us — игра про космический корабль и одного предателя в команде.
text:
You are on a spaceship with your friends. Everybody is working. Somebody fixes the wires. Somebody empties the rubbish. And one of you is a killer.

Among Us is a game from Innersloth, a very small American studio. It came out in 2018, and at first not many people played it. Then, in 2020, popular streamers started to play it online. Millions of people were at home that year, and everybody wanted to be on the spaceship.

The characters are little astronauts in bright colours. They look a bit like beans with a window in the face. Most players are crewmates. Their job is to finish small tasks around the ship. But one, two or three players are impostors. An impostor is a person who pretends to be someone else. The impostors pretend to work, but secretly they kill the crewmates.

When someone finds a body, all the players meet and talk. Who was in the cafeteria? Who was near the engines? Then everybody votes, and often one player flies out into space.

The game made a new word popular: “sus”. It is short for “suspicious”. When your friend says, “Red is sus,” it means, “I think Red is the impostor.” Careful! Sometimes Red did nothing wrong, and the real impostor is the friend who spoke first.

questions.q: What do crewmates do?
o: They finish small tasks on the ship.
They fly the ship to Mars.

questions.q: When did the game become very popular?
What does “sus” mean?

title: A House That Flies
ru: Мультфильм Pixar о старике, который улетел в Южную Америку на доме с шариками.
text:
Can a house fly? In Up, it can. You only need a few thousand balloons and a very stubborn old man.

Up is an animated film from Pixar. It came out in 2009, and Pete Docter directed it. The hero is Carl Fredricksen, a grumpy 78-year-old with a square face and thick glasses. For many years he sold balloons at the zoo, so he knows a lot about them.

When Carl was a boy, he met Ellie, a loud, brave girl who loved adventure. They grew up, got married and shared one big dream: to live next to Paradise Falls, a wild waterfall in South America. But life was always busy, and there was never enough money for the trip. Now Ellie is gone, builders want his land, and Carl is alone. So one morning he ties thousands of balloons to the house and flies away.

There is one problem. Russell, a round, talkative boy scout, was standing on the porch when the house took off. He needs just one more badge, for helping an old person, and Carl is the only old person around.

In South America they find a giant colourful bird that Russell names Kevin, and Dug, a dog with a special collar. The collar turns his thoughts into words, so Dug can talk. He is sweet and loyal, but he forgets everything the moment he sees a squirrel.

Near the start, the film tells the story of Carl and Ellie's life together, with music and almost no words. It is so beautiful that many people cry in the first ten minutes. Up was also the first animated film to open the Cannes Film Festival, and it won two Oscars. Keep some tissues nearby.

questions.q: Why does Carl know a lot about balloons?
o: He made them in a factory
He sold them at the zoo for many years

questions.q: How can Dug talk?
o: His special collar turns his thoughts into words

questions.q: What is special about the start of the film?
o: It tells Carl and Ellie's life with music and almost no words
It shows the house flying over the ocean
It begins with a song by Russell

title: Music, Family and Marigolds
ru: Мультфильм о мексиканском мальчике, который мечтает о музыке и попадает в Страну мёртвых.
text:
Imagine a family where music is against the rules. No singing, no guitars, not even a radio. This is the world of Miguel Rivera, the twelve-year-old hero of Coco.

Coco is a Pixar film from 2017, directed by Lee Unkrich. It takes place in a small Mexican town called Santa Cecilia. Miguel's family makes shoes, and they hate music for a reason: many years ago, Miguel's great-great-grandfather left his wife and daughter to become a musician, and he never came back. But Miguel secretly loves music. He practises on a homemade guitar and watches old films of his hero, the famous singer Ernesto de la Cruz.

The story happens on the Day of the Dead, a real Mexican holiday. Families put photos of dead relatives on a special table called an ofrenda, and they make a path of orange marigold flowers. People believe the flowers help the dead find their way home for one night.

When Miguel plays a famous old guitar, something strange happens. Suddenly he is in the Land of the Dead, a huge, bright city full of happy skeletons. Here he meets his dead relatives, a funny trickster called Héctor, and Dante, a silly hairless dog who follows him everywhere. But Miguel must go home before sunrise, or he will stay in the Land of the Dead forever.

The film is full of colour, music and Mexican culture, and almost all the main characters have Mexican or Latino voices. Coco won two Oscars, one for the best animated film and one for its song “Remember Me”. And the title? Coco is not Miguel. She is his very old great-grandmother.

questions.q: Why does Miguel's family hate music?
o: Music is too loud in their small town
A musician in the family left his wife and daughter
They lost their money because of a guitar

questions.q: What is an ofrenda?
o: A special table with photos of dead relatives

questions.q: Who is Coco?

title: A Rabbit in the Police
ru: Мультфильм Disney о крольчихе-полицейской и хитром лисе в городе животных.
text:
In the city of Zootopia, a tiny rabbit wants a very big job. Everyone laughs at her dream, but Judy Hopps does not care.

Zootopia is a Disney animated film from 2016, directed by Byron Howard and Rich Moore. It shows a modern city where animals live together and nobody eats anybody. The city has different parts for different animals: a hot desert area, a freezing snowy area, a rainy forest and a tiny town where mice live in little houses.

Judy comes from a quiet farm town where her family grows carrots. She works harder than everyone at the police school, and she becomes the first rabbit police officer in Zootopia. But the chief, a huge, unfriendly buffalo, does not believe in her. On her first day he gives her the most boring job in the city: parking tickets.

Then Judy meets Nick Wilde, a clever fox who tricks people for money. Nick is relaxed, lazy and very funny. Judy needs his help to find a missing animal, and she has only 48 hours to do it. The rabbit and the fox do not trust each other at all, which makes their partnership great fun to watch.

The most famous scene happens in a government office where all the workers are sloths. Every word, every smile and every stamp takes forever.

Under the jokes, the film talks about a serious problem: people often judge others because of what they look like. Zootopia won the Oscar for best animated film. Fun fact: in Britain and many other countries, the film has a slightly different name: Zootropolis.

questions.q: What is Judy's first job as a police officer?
How much time does Judy have to find the missing animal?
Why is the scene in the government office so funny?
o: All the workers are very slow sloths

title: The Voices in Your Head
ru: Мультфильм Pixar об эмоциях, которые живут в голове девочки Райли.
text:
Have you ever wondered who makes the decisions inside your head? Inside Out gives a funny and surprising answer: five small emotions with a control panel.

Inside Out is a Pixar film from 2015, directed by Pete Docter. Its hero is Riley, an eleven-year-old girl who loves hockey and her family. Inside her mind, in a place called Headquarters, live Joy, Sadness, Anger, Fear and Disgust. Joy is bright and full of energy, and she is the leader. Anger is short and red, and when he gets really angry, fire shoots out of his head. Disgust says no to everything she finds gross, especially broccoli.

Riley's memories look like little glass balls, and each ball has the colour of an emotion. The most important ones are core memories. They power the Islands of Personality, like Hockey Island and Family Island.

Then Riley's family moves from Minnesota to San Francisco. The new house is small and dark, Riley misses her friends, and even the local pizza has broccoli on it. Joy tries hard to keep everything happy, but things go wrong. Joy and Sadness get lost far away from Headquarters, and Anger, Fear and Disgust have to drive Riley alone. You can probably guess that this does not go well.

On their long trip back, Joy and Sadness meet Bing Bong, Riley's forgotten imaginary friend. He is part elephant, part cat, part dolphin, and made of cotton candy. When he cries, he cries sweets.

The film won the Oscar for best animated film. A fun detail: in Japan, the broccoli became green peppers, because many Japanese children hate those more. In 2024 a sequel came out with new emotions, such as Anxiety.

questions.q: Who is the leader of the emotions at the start?
What happens when Joy and Sadness get lost?
o: Anger, Fear and Disgust have to control Riley alone
Bing Bong takes control of Headquarters

questions.q: Why is the broccoli different in the Japanese version?
o: Broccoli does not grow in Japan
The director did not like broccoli
Many Japanese children hate green peppers more

title: A Rat Who Can Cook
ru: Мультфильм Pixar о крысе Реми, который мечтает стать поваром в Париже.
text:
Most chefs would scream if they saw a rat in the kitchen. In Ratatouille, the rat is the best cook in Paris.

Ratatouille is a Pixar film from 2007, directed by Brad Bird. Its hero, Remy, lives with a big rat family in the French countryside. His family eats rubbish and does not understand him. Remy has an amazing nose, and he wants to cook real food, like his hero, the famous chef Auguste Gusteau. Gusteau wrote a book called Anyone Can Cook, and Remy believes every word of it.

One day Remy loses his family and ends up alone in Paris, right next to Gusteau's restaurant. The great chef is dead now, but Remy often sees him as a friendly little ghost who talks to him. In the restaurant kitchen, Remy meets Linguini, a shy, clumsy young man who takes out the rubbish there. Linguini cannot cook at all, and Remy cannot let anyone see him: a rat in a kitchen is a disaster. So they make a strange deal: Remy hides under Linguini's chef's hat and pulls his hair to control his arms, like a puppet.

Of course, keeping a rat a secret in a busy kitchen is not easy. And there is also Anton Ego, a cold, thin food critic. One bad review from him can kill a restaurant.

The real dish ratatouille is a simple vegetable stew from the south of France. The American chef Thomas Keller helped the film team, and the beautiful ratatouille in the film is his fancy version. Many fans cook it at home today. Ratatouille won the Oscar for best animated film, and Disneyland Paris even has a Ratatouille ride.

questions.q: What is Remy's special talent?
o: He has an amazing nose for food

questions.q: How does Remy control Linguini?
o: He hides under his hat and pulls his hair
He gives him notes in the kitchen
He talks to him through a phone

questions.q: Who is Anton Ego?
o: A food critic whose bad review can kill a restaurant

title: A Viking and His Dragon
ru: Мультфильм DreamWorks о юном викинге Иккинге, который подружился с драконом.
text:
On the island of Berk, life is simple: dragons steal your sheep, and you fight them. Every Viking wants to kill a dragon. Every Viking except one.

How to Train Your Dragon is a DreamWorks film from 2010, directed by Chris Sanders and Dean DeBlois. It is based on children's books by the British writer Cressida Cowell. The hero, Hiccup, is the son of the chief, Stoick the Vast, a giant man with a giant red beard. Hiccup is the opposite: thin, clumsy and always talking. He is not strong, but he is clever, and he loves building machines.

One night, during a dragon attack, Hiccup uses one of his machines and catches a Night Fury, the fastest and most dangerous dragon of all. Nobody believes him. When he finds the dragon in the forest, he has the perfect chance to kill it, but he looks into its frightened eyes and cannot do it.

The dragon is hurt. Part of its tail fin is missing, so it cannot fly. Hiccup secretly builds a new tail fin for it, and soon he discovers that dragons are not monsters at all. He calls the dragon Toothless, because it can hide its teeth. Toothless acts a lot like a big black cat: he is proud, curious and sometimes very silly.

At the same time, Hiccup must go to dragon-fighting classes with other young Vikings, including the tough girl Astrid. He has a big secret now, and keeping it gets harder every day.

The flying scenes are amazing, and John Powell's music makes them even better. The film had two sequels, and in 2025 it came back as a live-action film with real actors. Fun fact: in the books, Toothless is a tiny dragon.

questions.q: Why does Hiccup not kill the dragon in the forest?
o: He looks into its frightened eyes and cannot do it
His father tells him to stop

questions.q: Why can't Toothless fly?
o: Part of his tail is missing

questions.q: How is Toothless different in the books?

title: Many Spider-People
ru: Мультфильм о подростке Майлзе Моралесе, который становится Человеком-пауком.
text:
You know Spider-Man. But do you know Spider-Man Noir, Spider-Gwen and a cartoon pig called Spider-Ham? In this film, they all meet in one city.

Spider-Man: Into the Spider-Verse is an animated film from Sony Pictures Animation. It came out in 2018. The hero is Miles Morales, a teenager from Brooklyn. Miles likes music, drawing and street art. His father is a police officer who does not like Spider-Man very much. One night a strange spider bites Miles, and the next morning his body starts doing crazy things. His hands stick to everything, including a girl's hair.

Meanwhile, a powerful criminal called Kingpin builds a giant machine that opens doors to other worlds. Because of this, Spider-People from different universes fall into Miles's New York. There is Peter B. Parker, a tired, older Spider-Man with a bit of a belly. There is Gwen Stacy, a cool spider-girl. There is Spider-Man Noir from the 1930s, who lives in black and white. There is Peni Parker, an anime girl with a robot, and of course Spider-Ham. They cannot stay in the wrong world for long, because it slowly breaks their bodies. They need to go home, and they need Miles's help. The problem is that Miles cannot control his powers yet.

The film looks like a comic book that comes to life. You can see small printed dots, text boxes and lines that show sound and movement. At the start, the animators even moved Miles a little less smoothly than the others, because he was still learning.

Into the Spider-Verse won the Oscar for best animated film, and its main idea is simple and strong: anyone can wear the mask. A sequel, Across the Spider-Verse, came out in 2023.

questions.q: What does Miles's father do?
Why do Spider-People from other worlds come to Miles's New York?
o: Kingpin's machine opens doors to other worlds
A spider bites all of them

questions.q: Why did the animators move Miles less smoothly at the start?
o: It looked more like an old cartoon
He was still learning to be Spider-Man

title: The Boy Who Controls the Air
ru: Мультсериал о мальчике Аанге, который должен вернуть мир четырём народам.
text:
Water, Earth, Fire, Air. In this world, some people can control one of these elements with their bodies. Only one person can control all four, and he is a twelve-year-old boy who loves penguin sledding.

Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated series created by Michael Dante DiMartino and Bryan Konietzko. It ran on Nickelodeon from 2005 to 2008. The world has four nations: the Water Tribes, the Earth Kingdom, the Fire Nation and the Air Nomads. People who can control an element are called benders. The Avatar is the only person who can bend all four elements and keep peace between the nations.

But a hundred years ago, the Avatar disappeared, and the Fire Nation started a terrible war. One day, at the cold South Pole, a girl called Katara and her brother Sokka find a boy frozen inside an iceberg. His name is Aang, he is an airbender, and he is the Avatar. He was asleep in the ice for a whole century.

Aang is kind and playful, but now he has a huge job. He must learn the other three elements and stop the war. He travels with Katara, a strong waterbender, Sokka, who makes a lot of jokes, a giant flying bison called Appa and a lemur called Momo. Prince Zuko of the Fire Nation chases them everywhere, because he must catch the Avatar to win back his father's respect. His gentle uncle Iroh, who loves tea, travels with him. Many fans think Zuko has the best story in the whole show.

Here is a cool detail: each kind of bending uses moves from a real Chinese martial art. The series has three seasons, which are called Books: Water, Earth and Fire.

questions.q: Where do Katara and Sokka find Aang?
o: Inside an iceberg at the South Pole
On the back of a flying bison

questions.q: Why does Prince Zuko chase Aang?
o: He wants to win back his father's respect

questions.q: What are the seasons of the show called?

title: A Very Strange Summer
ru: Мультсериал о близнецах Диппере и Мейбл, которые проводят лето в загадочном городке.
text:
Twelve-year-old twins Dipper and Mabel Pines expected a boring summer in the woods. Instead they found monsters, secret codes and a very suspicious great-uncle.

Gravity Falls is an animated series created by Alex Hirsch. It ran on the Disney Channel and Disney XD from 2012 to 2016. Dipper and Mabel's parents send them to Gravity Falls, a small town in Oregon, to stay with their great-uncle Stan. The kids call him Grunkle Stan. He runs the Mystery Shack, a shop for tourists that is full of fake monsters and expensive souvenirs. Stan loves money more than anything, but he secretly loves the twins too.

Dipper is serious and nervous, and he always wants answers. In the forest he finds an old book with a six-fingered hand on the cover. The book describes all the strange creatures in Gravity Falls: gnomes, ghosts, zombies and much worse. Inside, the unknown author wrote a warning: trust no one.

Mabel is the opposite of her brother. She wears bright, funny sweaters, she believes every day is an adventure, and she owns a pet pig called Waddles. Together they solve one mystery after another, and every little mystery is part of a much bigger one.

Two workers at the Shack help them: Soos, a big, sweet handyman, and Wendy, a cool teenage girl who works at the cash desk.

Here is the best surprise. At the end of each episode there is a secret code, and fans spent years solving them. Alex Hirsch also based Mabel on his own twin sister, and he gave his voice to Grunkle Stan. The show has only two seasons, because Hirsch wanted to finish the story at the perfect moment.

questions.q: What is the Mystery Shack?
o: A shop for tourists full of fake monsters
A secret laboratory in the forest
The twins' house in the city

questions.q: What warning is in Dipper's book?
Who was Mabel based on?

title: A Boy, a Dog and a Magic Land
ru: Мультсериал о мальчике Финне и его волшебном псе Джейке в Стране Ууу.
text:
A boy in a white hat with bear ears. A yellow dog who can stretch his body into anything, from a boat to a giant key. A princess made of bubblegum. Welcome to the Land of Ooo.

Adventure Time is an animated series created by Pendleton Ward. It ran on Cartoon Network from 2010 to 2018. The heroes are Finn the Human, a brave twelve-year-old boy at the start of the show, and his best friend Jake the Dog, who is also something like his brother. Finn wants to be a great hero, so he fights monsters, saves princesses and explores strange places. Jake is older, more relaxed and very lazy, but his magic powers save them again and again.

The world around them is wonderfully weird. Princess Bubblegum rules the Candy Kingdom, and she is also a brilliant scientist. The Ice King kidnaps princesses because he wants a wife, but he is more sad than evil. Marceline the Vampire Queen is a thousand years old and plays rock songs on a bass guitar. Finn and Jake also live with BMO, a small game console with legs, a face and a big personality.

At first the show looks like a silly cartoon for kids. But careful viewers notice strange things in the background: old ruined cities, broken cars, buried bombs. Slowly the series becomes deeper, sadder and more grown-up.

The show began as a short cartoon in 2007, which became very popular online. Later there were several new specials and series. And here is a fun connection: the same actor, John DiMaggio, plays Jake and Bender, the rude robot from Futurama. Listen to their voices, and you will hear it.

questions.q: What special power does Jake have?
o: He can stretch his body into anything

questions.q: What do careful viewers notice in the background?
o: Old ruined cities and buried bombs

questions.q: Which other character does John DiMaggio play?

title: Welcome to the Year 3000
ru: Мультсериал Мэтта Грейнинга о курьере Фрае, который проснулся через тысячу лет.
text:
On the last night of 1999, a pizza delivery boy falls into a freezing machine. When he wakes up, it is the last night of 2999. And honestly, his new life is much better than the old one.

Futurama is an American animated series created by Matt Groening, the man behind The Simpsons. It started in 1999. The hero, Philip J. Fry, is lazy, not very smart and totally unimportant in the 20th century. In the 31st century, in a city called New New York, he gets a job with Planet Express, a delivery company that flies packages across space. The owner is a crazy, very old scientist, Professor Farnsworth, and he is Fry's very distant nephew.

The Planet Express crew is unforgettable. Leela is the brave captain, and she has only one big eye. Bender is a rude robot who steals, lies, smokes cigars and loves himself more than anything. And Dr. Zoidberg is an alien doctor who looks like a lobster and knows almost nothing about human bodies.

The future in Futurama is full of great jokes. The heads of famous people from the past live in glass jars, and you can still talk to them. Robots have their own religion, and everyone drinks a popular green soda called Slurm. You do not want to know how they make it.

Futurama also has a strange history. Fox stopped the show in 2003, but it came back on Comedy Central. Then it stopped again, and in 2023 it returned on Hulu.

Some of the writers studied maths and science at top universities. One of them, Ken Keeler, even proved a real new maths theorem for an episode. Yes, a cartoon about a robot with a bad attitude has its own theorem.

questions.q: How does Fry get to the year 3000?
o: He falls into a freezing machine
He travels in a time machine

questions.q: Who is Professor Farnsworth?
o: The owner of Planet Express and Fry's distant nephew

questions.q: What did the writer Ken Keeler do for an episode?
o: He proved a real new maths theorem

title: Meet the Parents, Ogre Style
ru: Шрек едет знакомиться с родителями Фионы, а в истории появляется Кот в сапогах.
text:
Meeting your partner's parents is always stressful. Now imagine you are a big green ogre, and they are the king and queen.

Shrek 2 is an animated comedy from DreamWorks. It came out in 2004, three years after the first Shrek. At the start, Shrek and Fiona come home from their honeymoon very happy. Then a letter arrives. Fiona's parents want to meet her new husband. They live in the kingdom of Far Far Away, a funny copy of Hollywood, with shops like “Farbucks” and a big sign on the hill.

There is one small problem. When her parents last saw Fiona, she was a human princess. Now she is an ogre, and she is married to an ogre. When the couple arrives in a carriage that looks like a big onion, the crowd goes silent. King Harold is shocked, and dinner with the family quickly becomes a disaster. Shrek and the king do not like each other at all.

The king also has a secret deal. The Fairy Godmother, a powerful woman who sings and does magic, wanted Fiona to marry her son, the handsome and very vain Prince Charming. So the king hires a famous killer to get rid of Shrek. The killer is Puss in Boots, a little orange cat with a big hat, a sword and a Spanish accent. When he is in trouble, he makes huge, sad eyes, and nobody can say no to him. Antonio Banderas gave him his voice.

Of course, Donkey is back too, and he is jealous of the new cat.

Shrek 2 was the most successful film in the world in 2004. Puss in Boots became so popular that he later got two films of his own.

questions.q: Why are Fiona's parents shocked?
o: Fiona is now an ogre and married to an ogre

questions.q: What can Puss in Boots do when he is in trouble?
Why is Donkey unhappy?
o: He is jealous of the new cat

title: A Funny Day at the Office
ru: Комедия о скучном офисе, которую снимают как документальный фильм
text:
Michael Scott has a coffee mug that says “World's Best Boss”. He bought it himself.

The Office is an American comedy series. It ran on NBC from 2005 to 2013. Greg Daniels made it, and it is based on a British show with the same name by Ricky Gervais and Stephen Merchant. It takes place in the most ordinary place you can imagine: the office of Dunder Mifflin, a small paper company in Scranton, Pennsylvania. People sell paper, answer phones and wait for the weekend.

The show looks like a documentary. A camera team follows the workers all day, and they often speak to the camera alone. The best jokes are sometimes silent. Something stupid happens, and one character simply looks into the camera. You understand everything.

Michael Scott, played by Steve Carell, is the boss. He wants to be everyone's best friend and the funniest man in the room, but he usually says exactly the wrong thing. Dwight Schrute is his most loyal worker. He has a beet farm, takes himself very seriously and dreams of power. Jim Halpert sits opposite Dwight, and he is bored, clever and always ready for a prank. In the first episode, Dwight finds his stapler inside a big jelly. Pam Beesly, the quiet receptionist, often helps Jim with his tricks, and everyone can see that they like each other. Their slow love story is one of the best parts of the show.

The Office was not a big hit at the start. But it became more and more popular, and years later it became one of the most watched shows on streaming services. People come back to it again and again, like an old friend.

questions.q: Where did Michael get his “World's Best Boss” mug?
o: His workers gave it to him
He won it in a competition

questions.q: What does Dwight find inside a jelly?
What is often the best kind of joke on the show?
o: A character silently looks into the camera

title: Scientists Next Door
ru: Ситком о молодых учёных-гиках и их соседке Пенни
text:
Knock, knock, knock. “Penny.” Knock, knock, knock. “Penny.” Knock, knock, knock. “Penny.” If you smiled at this, you probably know this show and its strangest hero.

The Big Bang Theory is an American sitcom created by Chuck Lorre and Bill Prady. It ran on CBS from 2007 to 2019. The story takes place in Pasadena, California. Leonard and Sheldon are physicists who work at a university and share an apartment. They are brilliant at science and terrible at almost everything else, especially talking to people.

Then Penny moves into the apartment across the hall. She is friendly and funny, she works as a waitress and she dreams of becoming an actress. She knows nothing about science, comics or Star Trek, and the guys know nothing about normal life. Leonard falls for her immediately.

Their friends make the group complete. Howard is an engineer who thinks he is a great lover. Raj is an astrophysicist from India who is so shy that he cannot speak to women at all. But the biggest star is Sheldon. He has a special spot on the sofa, and nobody can sit there. He follows strict rules for everything, and when he plays a trick on someone, he shouts “Bazinga!”

The show was full of real science. A physics professor checked the formulas on the whiteboards in every episode. Here is another fun detail: the elevator in Leonard and Sheldon's building is broken for almost the whole series, so the characters always walk up and down the stairs.

The Big Bang Theory lasted 12 seasons and 279 episodes. Later, a prequel series, Young Sheldon, told the story of Sheldon's childhood in Texas.

Why can't Raj talk to women?

title: A Very Long Love Story
ru: Тед рассказывает детям долгую историю о том, как встретил их маму
text:
“Kids, I'm going to tell you an incredible story.” This is how Ted Mosby begins. In the year 2030 he sits his teenage son and daughter on the sofa and tells them how he met their mother. The story takes nine seasons.

How I Met Your Mother is an American sitcom created by Carter Bays and Craig Thomas. It ran on CBS from 2005 to 2014. Most of the story happens in New York, years earlier, when Ted was a young architect looking for true love. He spends almost every evening with his friends in MacLaren's, a small bar under his apartment.

The group is a lot of fun. Marshall and Lily are the perfect couple. They met in college, and now they are getting married. Robin is a Canadian TV journalist who loves guns and hockey and does not want a serious relationship. Barney is a rich ladies' man who always wears a suit and tells his friends to “Suit up!” He is also famous for the word “legendary”, which he says with a long pause in the middle.

The show has a clever way of telling stories. Old Ted is the narrator, and he is not always reliable. He forgets details, mixes up the order of events and even changes things so his kids will not hear the truth. When the friends smoke in the story, for example, he says they are eating sandwiches. Little details from early episodes often become important many seasons later, so careful viewers get many rewards.

For most of the series we see only small clues about the mother, such as a yellow umbrella. Fans still argue about the final episode, but almost everyone agrees that the journey is wonderful.

questions.q: Who is Ted telling the story to?
What does old Ted say when the friends smoke in the story?
What is one small clue about the mother?

title: The Funniest Police Station
ru: Комедия о детективах из полицейского участка в Бруклине
text:
Jake Peralta is the best detective in his police station. He is also a big child who loves pranks, pizza and action films. His new captain is a man who almost never smiles. You can see the problem.

Brooklyn Nine-Nine is an American comedy series created by Dan Goor and Michael Schur. It started on Fox in 2013 and ended in 2021. It takes place in the 99th police station, or precinct, in Brooklyn, New York. The detectives there catch real criminals, but most of the fun happens between the cases.

Jake, played by Andy Samberg, is clever and brave, but he never follows the rules. Captain Raymond Holt is his opposite. He speaks in a calm, flat voice, shows almost no emotion and loves order. Watching these two men slowly become friends is one of the joys of the show.

The rest of the team is just as colourful. Amy Santiago loves rules, plans and binders, and she always wants to be the best student in the class. Rosa Diaz wears a leather jacket, says very little and scares everyone. Charles Boyle is Jake's most loyal friend, and he is crazy about strange food. Terry Jeffords is a huge, muscular sergeant who loves yoghurt and his little daughters.

Every year the team has a special Halloween competition called the Heist. The detectives try to steal one special object from each other, and the winner gets to call themselves an “amazing detective and genius” for a whole year.

Here is a famous story about the show. In 2018 Fox cancelled it. Fans and celebrities protested loudly on the internet, and the next day another channel, NBC, saved it. The show continued for three more seasons.

questions.q: What is Captain Holt like?
What happens every year at Halloween?
o: The detectives try to steal one object

questions.q: What happened after Fox cancelled the show in 2018?
o: The actors made a film instead
NBC saved it the next day

title: One Big Crazy Family
ru: Ситком о трёх семьях, которые вместе составляют одну большую
text:
One grandfather, his young wife from Colombia, a very serious little boy who loves poetry, three noisy kids, two dads and a lot of chaos. This is one family. It just takes a while to explain.

Modern Family is an American sitcom created by Christopher Lloyd and Steven Levitan. It ran on ABC from 2009 to 2020. Like The Office, it looks like a documentary, and the characters often talk to the camera about their day. The family lives in Los Angeles.

At the top of the family tree is Jay Pritchett, a grumpy older businessman. He is married to Gloria, a beautiful, loud and very emotional woman from Colombia. Gloria's son Manny is only a boy, but he acts like a little old gentleman. He wears nice jackets, writes poems and falls in love with older girls.

Jay's daughter Claire is a strict mother who wants to control everything. Her husband Phil is a real estate agent who believes he is a “cool dad”. He knows all the dance moves from High School Musical, he loves magic tricks, and he laughs at his own jokes. Their three children are very different: Haley loves fashion and parties, Alex is the smartest person in the house, and Luke lives in his own strange world.

Jay's son Mitchell is a nervous lawyer. He and his partner Cameron adopted a baby girl, Lily, from Vietnam. Cam is warm and dramatic, and every small problem becomes a big show. He was even a professional clown once, and his clown name was Fizbo.

The jokes are fast, but the show also has a big heart. Modern Family won the Emmy for best comedy series five years in a row, and it ran for eleven seasons.

questions.q: How does Manny act?
What does Phil believe about himself?
o: He is the smartest person in the house

questions.q: What was Cam's job once?

title: Sherlock with a Smartphone
ru: Шерлок Холмс в современном Лондоне: телефоны, интернет и загадки
text:
In the old books, Sherlock Holmes has a pipe and a horse carriage. In this series, he has a smartphone, nicotine patches and a lot of text messages.

Sherlock is a British crime series from the BBC, created by Steven Moffat and Mark Gatiss. It ran from 2010 to 2017. The idea is simple: what if the famous detective lived in modern London? Benedict Cumberbatch plays Sherlock, and Martin Freeman plays his friend Dr. John Watson.

The story starts when Watson, an army doctor, comes back from the war in Afghanistan. He is lonely, he does not have much money, and he needs a cheaper place to live. A friend introduces him to Sherlock. In just a few seconds, Sherlock looks at him and tells him everything about his life. Soon the two men share a flat at 221B Baker Street, the same address as in the books. Their landlady, Mrs Hudson, often reminds them that she is not their housekeeper.

This Sherlock is brilliant, fast and rude. He gets bored easily, he does not care about other people's feelings, and he calls himself “a high-functioning sociopath”. Watson is his opposite: calm, kind and brave. He also writes a blog about their cases, which makes them both famous. Later they meet Moriarty, a criminal genius who is as clever as Sherlock and far more dangerous.

The series looks modern too. When Sherlock studies a person or a room, small words appear on the screen and show his thoughts. Each season has only three episodes, but each one is about ninety minutes long, like a film.

A fun fact: in the same years, Martin Freeman played Bilbo in The Hobbit films, and Cumberbatch gave his voice to Smaug, the dragon. The detective and the doctor met again in Middle-earth.

questions.q: Why does Watson need a new place to live?
o: He is lonely and does not have much money
Sherlock asks him to move in

questions.q: How many episodes does each season have?
Who did Benedict Cumberbatch voice in The Hobbit?

title: A Lonely Hunter and a Tiny Friend
ru: Первый игровой сериал по «Звёздным войнам»: охотник за головами и малыш Грогу
text:
A silent warrior in metal armour walks into a dark bar. He never takes off his helmet. Nobody knows his face. And very soon, he will become a babysitter.

The Mandalorian is a series from the Star Wars universe, created by Jon Favreau. It started on Disney+ in 2019, and it was the first live-action Star Wars series. The story happens a few years after Return of the Jedi. The evil Empire has fallen, but the galaxy is still a dangerous, lawless place.

The hero is a bounty hunter, a man who catches people for money. Everyone calls him the Mandalorian, or simply Mando, and Pedro Pascal plays him. Mando follows a strict code: a true Mandalorian never shows his face to anyone. His people have a short, famous saying: “This is the way.”

One day Mando gets a well-paid job. He must find a mysterious “asset” and bring it to a client. When he finally finds it, it is not a weapon or a treasure. It is a small green child with big ears and huge dark eyes. The child is fifty years old, but he is still a baby, and he has strange powers. Fans immediately named him Baby Yoda, and the internet went crazy. Later in the show we learn his real name: Grogu.

Mando has to make a hard choice. What follows feels like an old Western film: a lonely gunman, a long road and a child who needs protection. Grogu does not speak, but he is very good at eating frogs and pressing buttons that he should not press.

The series also changed how films and shows are made. Instead of a green screen, the actors stood inside a giant room of LED screens that showed alien worlds around them.

questions.q: What is Mando's strict rule?
o: He never shows his face to anyone

questions.q: What is the mysterious “asset”?
What did the actors stand inside instead of a green screen?
o: A giant room of LED screens
A spaceship from the old films

title: The Nicest Coach in England
ru: Американский тренер, не знающий футбола, возглавляет английский клуб
text:
An American coach who knows nothing about football becomes the manager of an English football club. It sounds like a joke, but it is one of the warmest comedies on television.

Ted Lasso is a series from Apple's streaming service, Apple TV. It started in 2020, and Jason Sudeikis plays Ted and helped to create the show. Ted first appeared in short funny adverts for American TV, where he was an American coach in England. The idea worked so well that it became a full series.

At the start, Ted coaches an American football team at a college in Kansas. Suddenly he gets an offer from AFC Richmond, a club in the top English league. Ted does not even know the rules of the game that Americans call soccer. He does not understand why a game can end in a draw, and he cannot stand English tea. So why does the club want him? The new owner, Rebecca, secretly hopes that he will destroy the team. Her ex-husband loves the club, and she wants to hurt him.

But Ted is impossible to hate. He has a big moustache, a million jokes and endless optimism. He puts a simple sign over his office door: BELIEVE. Every morning he brings Rebecca a small box of homemade biscuits, and slowly the cold boss starts to smile.

The players have their own stories too. Roy Kent is an old, angry star who growls more than he talks. Jamie Tartt is a young, selfish star who loves himself.

The show is funny, but it is also about kindness, sadness and getting better as a person. It won the Emmy for best comedy series two years in a row. Fun fact: AFC Richmond is not real, but Richmond is a real part of London.

questions.q: Why does Rebecca hire Ted?
o: He is the best coach in America
She hopes he will destroy the team

questions.q: What does Ted bring Rebecca every morning?
o: A small box of homemade biscuits

questions.q: Where did the character Ted Lasso first appear?
o: In short adverts for American TV

title: The Most Famous Coffee Shop on TV
ru: Central Perk — кофейня, где шесть друзей проводят свободное время
text:
Imagine a café where your favourite seat is always free. In real life, this almost never happens. In Friends, it happens every single day.

Friends was on NBC from 1994 to 2004. David Crane and Marta Kauffman created it, and it follows six young people in New York: Rachel, Monica, Phoebe, Joey, Chandler and Ross. Whatever happens in their lives, they always come back to the same place — a little coffee shop called Central Perk.

The café is warm and a bit old-fashioned, with brick walls and huge coffee cups. In the middle stands a big orange sofa. Somehow it is always empty when the friends arrive. Who keeps it free for them?

Gunther works behind the counter. He is a quiet man with very light, almost white hair. He secretly loves Rachel, but he almost never says a word about it. Fun fact: at first the actor was just a background extra — a person who stands at the back and doesn't speak. One reason he got the job was simple. He really knew how to use the coffee machine.

For a while, Rachel works at Central Perk too. She is a terrible waitress and often brings the wrong order. Phoebe sometimes plays her guitar there and sings her very strange songs.

Why does this place matter so much? Because it shows something we all want: a place where friends meet without any special reason. You just walk in, and they are there.

The café lives on. At the Warner Bros. studio tour in California, fans can sit on the famous sofa. And for the show's 20th birthday, a real Central Perk opened in New York for a few weeks. People waited in long lines just to buy a coffee there.

o: He was a friend of the creators
He knew how to use the coffee machine

questions.q: What is strange about the orange sofa?
o: It is too small for six people
It is always free when the friends arrive

questions.q: What happened for the show's 20th birthday?
o: The actors met in New York
A real Central Perk opened in New York

title: Bikes, Games and the 1980s
ru: Атмосфера 1980-х и настоящая дружба в «Очень странных делах»
text:
It is November 1983 in Hawkins, a small, quiet town in Indiana. Four boys are playing Dungeons & Dragons in a basement. Then one of them, Will Byers, rides his bike home through the dark woods — and never arrives.

This is how Stranger Things begins. The Duffer brothers, Matt and Ross, created the show, and it started on Netflix in 2016. The final season came out in 2025, and by then it was one of the biggest shows in the world.

The story has monsters, secret labs and a dark copy of our world called the Upside Down. But the real heart of the show is friendship. Mike, Dustin and Lucas don't wait for adults to find Will. They get on their bikes and look for him themselves. On the way they meet Eleven, a strange girl with very short hair and very few words. She has powers: she can move things with her mind. She also really loves frozen waffles.

The 1980s are everywhere. There are no mobile phones, so the kids talk on big walkie-talkies. They play games in an arcade and hang out at the shopping mall. Will's mother, Joyce, puts Christmas lights on the wall to talk to her missing son — one of the most famous images in the show. Even the music sounds like the eighties.

Here is a surprise. In 2022, an old Kate Bush song from 1985 played in an important scene, and suddenly millions of young people were listening to it. The song went to number one in the UK almost forty years after it first came out.

If you grew up in the eighties, the show feels like a memory. If you didn't, it feels like a time machine — with a monster inside.

title: A Monster Hunter on Netflix
ru: Геральт из Ривии, чародейка Йеннифэр и принцесса Цири в сериале Netflix
text:
He has white hair, yellow cat-like eyes and two swords on his back. He doesn't talk much. Very often he just says “Hmm.” His name is Geralt of Rivia, and his job is killing monsters for money.

Geralt comes from a series of books by the Polish writer Andrzej Sapkowski. Many people know him from the video games by CD Projekt Red, another Polish company. In 2019, Netflix made him the star of a TV series, The Witcher. Lauren Schmidt Hissrich created the show.

Why two swords? The steel one is for people. The silver one is for monsters. In this world, monsters are dangerous, but people are often worse.

Geralt is not the only hero. Yennefer is a powerful sorceress — a woman who uses magic. She is clever and proud, and she has a difficult past. Ciri is a young princess who has to run away when enemies take her city. Destiny connects all three of them, even when they don't want it.

Then there is Jaskier, a loud, cheerful bard — a travelling singer. He follows Geralt everywhere and never stops talking. One of his songs about Geralt became a real hit online, and fans sang it for months.

The first season surprised many viewers. It tells three stories that happen at different times, but it doesn't say this clearly. Some viewers only understood it after a few episodes!

Henry Cavill played Geralt in the first three seasons. He was a huge fan of the games and books before he got the role, and he often talked about them. In the fourth season, Liam Hemsworth became the new Geralt.

Watch it for the sword fights. Stay for the strange little family that grows between a witcher, a sorceress and a lost princess.

Who is Jaskier?
Why did the first season surprise many viewers?
o: It told three stories that happen at different times

title: Three Neighbours and a Podcast
ru: Трое соседей расследуют преступления и записывают об этом подкаст
text:
Three people live in the same expensive building in New York, but they don't know each other. Charles is an actor who once played a detective on TV. Oliver is a theatre director with big ideas and no money. Mabel is a young artist with secrets. They have only one thing in common: they all love true crime podcasts — shows about real crimes.

One night a fire alarm sends everyone out into the street, and the three of them meet for the first time. On the same night, a man from their building is found dead. The police say it is not a murder. The three neighbours don't believe it. So they decide to find the truth — and, of course, to make their own podcast about it.

Only Murders in the Building started on Hulu in 2021. Steve Martin and John Hoffman created it. Steve Martin plays Charles, Martin Short plays Oliver, and Selena Gomez plays Mabel. In real life, Martin and Short are old friends.

The best jokes come from the age difference. The two men are in their seventies, and Mabel is much younger. They don't understand her phone. She doesn't understand their old stories. Oliver wants every episode of the podcast to be big and dramatic, like one of his shows. Mabel just wants to solve the case.

The building, called the Arconia, is almost a fourth hero. It has old lifts, long dark corridors and neighbours who all look a little suspicious.

The show is funny, but it is also a real mystery. Each season has a new case, and famous guests keep arriving. In the third season, even Meryl Streep joined the cast.

You laugh, and at the same time you try to guess the killer.

o: They went to the same school
